ground.label: Background
ground.note: The colour behind the closing block. This section ends nearly every page, so it is the one worth varying between page types - four pages that all finish on the same colour is what makes a site feel repetitive.

plain.label: Default
plain.note: The page's own background, with the button in your brand colour. The quietest ending, and the right one where the section above it is already busy.

soft.label: Light
soft.note: A soft tint, so the ending is marked without shouting. A good middle choice for a page that has already made its case.

brand.label: Brand colour
brand.note: Your brand colour across the full width, with the button reversed out of it. The strongest ending and the loudest - best on the pages where signing up is the whole point.

deep.label: Dark
deep.note: A dark ground, confident and quiet at once. Suits a page that opened light, and gives a second strong ending that is not your brand colour again.
